# stalwart_network_listener (Data Source)

Defines a network listener for accepting incoming connections.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object. Set either `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Unique identifier for the listener

### Read-Only

- `bind` (Set of String) The addresses the listener will bind to
- `max_connections` (Number) The maximum number of concurrent connections the listener will accept
- `override_proxy_trusted_networks` (Set of String) Enable proxy protocol for connections from these networks
- `protocol` (String) The protocol used by the listener
- `socket_backlog` (Number) The maximum number of incoming connections that can be pending in the backlog queue
- `socket_no_delay` (Boolean) Whether the Nagle algorithm should be disabled for the socket
- `socket_receive_buffer_size` (Number) The size of the buffer used for receiving data
- `socket_reuse_address` (Boolean) Whether the socket can be bound to an address that is already in use by another socket
- `socket_reuse_port` (Boolean) Whether multiple sockets can be bound to the same address and port
- `socket_send_buffer_size` (Number) The size of the buffer used for sending data
- `socket_tos_v4` (Number) The type of service (TOS) value for the socket, which determines the priority of the traffic sent through the socket
- `socket_ttl` (Number) Time-to-live (TTL) value for the socket, which determines how many hops a packet can make before it is discarded
- `tls_disable_cipher_suites` (Set of String) Which cipher suites to disable
- `tls_disable_protocols` (Set of String) Which TLS protocols to disable
- `tls_ignore_client_order` (Boolean) Whether to ignore the client's cipher order
- `tls_implicit` (Boolean) Whether to use implicit TLS
- `tls_timeout` (Number) TLS handshake timeout
- `use_tls` (Boolean) Whether to enable TLS for this listener
